name: @chart-studio/root
description: Multi-provider charting platform — separate app, designed to be extracted into its own repo.

scripts.build: npm run -w @chart-studio/adapter-core build && npm run -w @chart-studio/indicator-runtime build && npm run -w @chart-studio/gateway build && npm run -w @chart-studio/adapter-binance build && npm run -w @chart-studio/adapter-dhanhq build && npm run -w @chart-studio/ai-engine build
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:binance" "npm run dev:dhanhq" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/adapter-core packages/gateway packages/adapter-binance packages/adapter-dhanhq packages/ai-engine
